run_bm_infer: run SingleSiteAncestralMetropolisHastings inference on a normal distribution random variable with queries and observations
run_bmg_infer: run BMGInference on a normal distribution random variable with queries and observations
export_to_dot: export a BeanMachine inference graph to DOT format using BMGInference to_dot method
export_to_cpp: export a BeanMachine inference graph to C++ code using BMGInference to_cpp method
export_to_python: export a BeanMachine inference graph to Python code using BMGInference to_python method
